storyCards.headline: Shut Up And Dance: The Breakthrough Moment
storyCards.fact:
Walk The Moon's "Shut Up And Dance" reached #4 on the Billboard Hot 100.

The song peaked at #4 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 53 weeks on the chart.

Shut Up And Dance was released in 2014.

Chart story — peaked at #4 on the Hot 100.
